description: Read the shots of a make_faceless or make_ugc video: frame size and rate, timed words, and each shot's span, kind, words and preview_url (it expires). A field named in `withheld` is null on every shot. planned=false is a normal answer: editable.reason says why. paid_edits.enabled says whether a video can be made from an edit; while it is false, none can. Free.
name: get_run_shots
title: Get the shots of a run
